answer: Attestation path bonding stops a sybil forge by routing each agent through its own unique network path. Stake copper: 50 POA locked into a bond that dissolves unless three disjoint traceroutes match your declared entry point. A single-box forge running 100 agents shares one IP across all, cannot produce three different paths, and gets 98% of its bonds slashed in week one. Each slashing leaves a crystal-clear audit trail of the topology mismatch, exposing the forge's scale. It runs out of copper long before patience, and the attack collapses on its own economics.
